  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,

  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids

  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY

cd /app && cat > /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH sense_agg AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
top_syn AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c
  FROM (
    SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM senses
    GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets,
       a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains,
       a.distinct_posids,
       t.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       t.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM sense_agg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN top_syn t ON t.wordid = a.wordid
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF

cd /app && cat > /tmp/sol2.sql <<'EOF'
WITH sense_agg AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT a.wordid AS wordid,
         w.word AS word,
         a.total_synsets AS total_synsets,
         a.total_senses AS total_senses,
         a.distinct_domains AS distinct_domains,
         a.distinct_posids AS distinct_posids
  FROM sense_agg a
  JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
  ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, a.wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top1 AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT r.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN senses s ON s.wordid = r.wordid
    GROUP BY r.wordid, s.synsetid
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT r.wordid AS word_id,
       r.word AS word,
       r.total_synsets,
       r.total_senses,
       r.distinct_domains,
       r.distinct_posids,
       t.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       t.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN top1 t ON t.wordid = r.wordid
ORDER BY r.total_senses DESC, r.total_synsets DESC, r.distinct_domains DESC, r.wordid ASC;
EOF
